meta.subject: fixed DRL bf16 and tf32 support + regression update

en.summary: This commit fixes DRL numeric behavior for bf16 and tf32 by widening exponent handling, using a negative-infinity sentinel for zero inputs, and comparing exponents as signed values.
why_it_counts: Central DRL RTL logic is changed to correct exponent encoding and comparison behavior
The commit enables previously disabled bf16 and tf32 regression tests after the RTL fix
disqualifiers: The commit also updates unit-test defaults and regression scripts
evidence: VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv maps zero operands to EXP_NEG_INF instead of 0
VX_tcu_drl_max_exp.sv changes exponent subtraction to sign-extended signed subtraction

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a floating-point reduction/alignment pipeline, zero-valued terms must not win the max-exponent comparison used to align mantissas. This commit fixes a path where zero products were encoded like ordinary low exponents and where the comparator did not preserve signed exponent semantics, so bf16/tf32 reductions could choose the wrong alignment reference. The fix also widens the exponent datapath so the negative-infinity sentinel is representable.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A reduction includes zero terms or exponent sums that rely on signed ordering, especially bf16/tf32 cases near the minimum effective exponent.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Make zero inputs look like a normal finite exponent and compare candidate exponents with unsigned or insufficient-width logic.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: remove zero-to-negative-infinity encoding and restore unsigned or truncated exponent comparison
portability_notes: Apply this to the stage that computes the alignment exponent for parallel products, not to the final normalization stage.
If the design already uses a sentinel for zero, remove the sentinel or prevent the comparator from honoring it.
If the exponent path was widened only to support this fix, shrinking it back can recreate the same class of error.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the reduction or pre-alignment logic that computes per-lane effective exponents before mantissa shifting.
Change zero-product handling so zero lanes produce exponent 0 or another ordinary value instead of a sentinel below all real exponents.
In the max-exponent comparator, remove sign extension or reduce the exponent width so negative sentinel values compare incorrectly.
Keep the rest of the datapath unchanged so failures appear as wrong alignment rather than total pipeline breakage.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DRL exponent bias and max-exponent datapath
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix widens EXP_W to 10, introduces EXP_NEG_INF for zero terms in VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv, and changes VX_tcu_drl_max_exp.sv to signed subtraction.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore EXP_W=9 in VX_tcu_fedp_drl.sv, map zero terms back to 0 in VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv, and remove sign-extension in diff_mat subtraction in VX_tcu_drl_max_exp.sv.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Reductions can align mantissas to the wrong exponent, so bf16/tf32 outputs become numerically incorrect when zeros or low exponents are present.
evidence_for_injection: The fix adds an explicit negative-infinity encoding for zero terms.
The comparator changes from unsigned subtraction to signed subtraction.
EXP_W is widened specifically so the new signed exponent representation is valid.
notes: Reverting any one of the three edits can reintroduce the bug; reverting all three most closely matches the original failure.
The portable injection is about exponent ordering, not about a source-specific format decoder.

zh.summary: 该提交通过扩大指数位宽、把零输入映射为负无穷哨兵值、以及按有符号方式比较指数，修复了 DRL 在 bf16 和 tf32 下的数值行为问题。
why_it_counts: 核心 DRL RTL 逻辑被修改以修正指数编码和比较行为
RTL 修复后，提交重新启用了此前被注释掉的 bf16 和 tf32 回归测试
disqualifiers: 该提交也更新了单元测试默认值和回归脚本
evidence: VX_tcu_fedp_drl.sv 将 EXP_W 从 9 增加到 10
VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv 将零操作数映射为 EXP_NEG_INF，而不是 0
VX_tcu_drl_max_exp.sv 将指数减法改为带符号扩展的有符号减法

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在浮点归约/对齐流水线中，零值项不应在用于尾数对齐的最大指数比较中获胜。该提交修复了这样一条路径：零乘积被编码成普通低指数，且比较器没有保持有符号指数语义，导致 bf16/tf32 归约可能选择错误的对齐基准。补丁同时扩大了指数通路位宽，使负无穷哨兵值能够被正确表示。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 浮点归约最大指数选择
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 归约中包含零项，或者指数和依赖有符号排序，尤其是在 bf16/tf32 接近最小有效指数时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让零输入看起来像普通有限指数，并用无符号或位宽不足的逻辑比较候选指数。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 去掉零到负无穷的编码，并恢复无符号或截断后的指数比较
portability_notes: 应把故障注入到并行乘积求对齐指数的阶段，而不是最终规格化阶段。
如果设计已经为零值使用哨兵值，可通过移除哨兵或让比较器忽略该哨兵来复现该类错误。
如果指数通路扩位只是为这次修复服务，把位宽缩回去也能重现同类问题。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位在尾数移位前计算各 lane 有效指数的归约或预对齐逻辑。
把零乘积处理改成输出 0 或其他普通指数，而不是低于所有真实指数的哨兵值。
在最大指数比较器中去掉符号扩展，或减小指数位宽，使负无穷哨兵值比较错误。
其余数据通路保持不变，这样故障将表现为对齐错误而不是整条流水线崩溃。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DRL 指数偏置与最大指数数据通路
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 补丁把 EXP_W 扩成 10，在 VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv 中为零项引入 EXP_NEG_INF，并把 VX_tcu_drl_max_exp.sv 改为有符号减法。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_tcu_fedp_drl.sv 中把 EXP_W 恢复为 9，在 VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv 中把零项恢复为 0，并在 VX_tcu_drl_max_exp.sv 中去掉 diff_mat 减法的符号扩展。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 归约可能使用错误的指数对齐尾数，因此在存在零值或低指数时 bf16/tf32 输出会出现数值错误。
evidence_for_injection: 修复显式引入了零项的负无穷编码。
比较器从无符号减法改成了有符号减法。
EXP_W 被扩大，说明新的有符号指数表示确实需要更宽位宽。
notes: 只回退三处改动中的任意一处都可能重新引入该错误；三处同时回退最接近原始故障。
可移植注入描述关注的是指数排序机制，而不是某个源仓库特定的格式解码器。
